canonical_project: 甘孜州能源大数据中心 (Ganzi Prefecture Energy Big Data Center)
owner: State Grid Ganzi Power Supply Company / Ganzi prefectural energy-data program
notes: People's Daily/Sichuan Online reported the center was formally established in Kangding on 2022-03-22 to support energy monitoring, carbon and clean-energy data products; sector-specific data center rather than commercial colocation.
